* feat(kit): SPKI cert pinning — ServerEndpoint.spkiHash + URLSession delegate (#29)

Implements ADR-0029 SPKI pinning end-to-end for the mobile connection path:

- ServerEndpoint gains an optional spkiHash: String? field (nil = no
  pinning, normal system TLS).  Back-compat: the field is Codable-optional
  so existing stored endpoint sets deserialise without it.
- SPKIPinningDelegate (new) is a URLSessionDelegate that intercepts
  NSURLAuthenticationMethodServerTrust challenges, evaluates the chain with
  SecTrustEvaluateWithError (system validation is not bypassed), extracts
  the leaf certificate's SubjectPublicKeyInfo via manual DER parsing, hashes
  it with CryptoKit SHA-256, and fails the connection on mismatch.  Uses
  SecTrustCopyCertificateChain (macOS 12+, available on our min targets) in
  place of the deprecated SecTrustGetCertificateAtIndex.
- BeamfallClient.pinnedSession(spkiHash:host:) builds an ephemeral
  URLSession backed by SPKIPinningDelegate scoped to an optional host.
- MobileConnectionModel adds resolvedEndpointAndSession() which calls
  ConnectionResolver.select() (returning the full ServerEndpoint, not just
  the URL string) and produces the right URLSession: pinned when
  spkiHash is present, hardenedSession otherwise.  connect() and
  resolveDownloadClient() both route through it.  Other call sites that
  resolve via configuredServerURL() are unchanged (they operate outside
  the endpoint-set probing path).
